outcome: Neonatal T-cell receptor excision circle (TREC) levels
Neonatal κ-deleting recombination excision circle (KREC) levels
cohort: 6,014 singleton infants born at ≥35 weeks gestation with Apgar scores ≥7 and no congenital malformations or neonatal morbidity
finding: Cesarean section before labor was associated with lower T-lymphocyte formation in infants, independent of other maternal and neonatal factors.
mod_finding: Cesarean section before labor was associated with lower T-lymphocyte formation in infants.
